simulate_metal_dipole: simulate a y-dipole above a metal plane with perfectly matched layers and return electric and magnetic fields
plot_metal_dipole_fields: simulate and plot the electromagnetic fields for a dipole spaced away from a metal plane
run_metal_dipole_simulation: run the metal dipole simulation with custom permittivity, wavelength, and PML parameters to compute 3D fields
review_simulate_metal_dipole: review the simulate_metal_dipole function to understand how it uses FMM eigensolve and scattering matrices for field computation
refactor_plot_metal_dipole_fields: refactor the plot_metal_dipole_fields function to support configurable output file paths and colormap options
